goal: Prevent node operators from running unaware that ZMQ notifications failed to start
Abort startup with an explicit error when configured ZMQ sockets fail to bind or initialize
agreement: General agreement that ZMQ bind failures should abort startup loudly
Concept approval after testing with port conflicts and misconfigurations (pinheadmz)
Approach approval verified through broken-config startup tests (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed objection: unnecessary intermediate helper function indirection, no author reply (pinheadmz)
